stage0_infrastructure_finding.summary: All 6 main-grid (d,beta) cells failed identically with fpylll.util.ReductionError: b'infinite loop in babai', raised inside BKZReduction's own internal LLL call (fpylll/algorithms/bkz.py line 123, self.lll_obj(), src/fpylll/fplll/lll.pyx line 305) -- NOT a cap timeout (all 6 finished in 53.7s-408.9s, all well under the 3600s PER_BASIS_FEASIBILITY_CAP) and NOT a completed reduction.
stage0_infrastructure_finding.recurrence: 6/6 main-grid cells, both d in {256,512}, all three beta in {40,55,70} -- fully systemic across the grid, not a one-off.
stage0_infrastructure_finding.reproducibility: Independently reproduced out-of-band for (d=256, beta=40) with the SAME seed_used=1398073216: identical exception, identical message.

side_diagnostic_float_type.purpose: Bounded, out-of-band check (NOT part of the official Stage-0 run or its recorded timings) of whether the error is a default-float_type precision artifact fixable by a documented fpylll GSO.Mat(float_type=...) parameter -- still native fpylll usage, not a hand-rolled BKZ substitute.
side_diagnostic_float_type.float_type_mpfr: FAILED -- identical ReductionError('infinite loop in babai'), effectively instantly. Rules out a simple default-precision explanation.
side_diagnostic_float_type.float_type_dd: FAILED -- ValueError: Float type 'dd' unknown (not compiled into this fpylll/fplll build).
side_diagnostic_float_type.float_type_qd: FAILED -- ValueError: Float type 'qd' unknown (not compiled into this fpylll/fplll build).
side_diagnostic_float_type.float_type_long_double: INCONCLUSIVE -- ran >600s without erroring or completing, then deliberately killed (SIGKILL) to stop it competing for CPU with the official Stage-0 subprocesses and biasing their wall-clock measurements. Whether it would eventually have succeeded or also errored is NOT determined by this task.
side_diagnostic_float_type.conclusion: The failure is not resolved by the one alternative float_type that could be tested to a definite result (mpfr) within this task's own scope; no further fpylll-native remedy (e.g. a different LLL delta, a different strategies file, an upstream fplll version) was attempted, per PREREG-8's own prohibition on any hand-rolled BKZ substitute and this task's own scope (Stage 0 feasibility measurement, not infrastructure repair).
